title: Theoretical evaluation of a bulky ortho-thioalkyl-azobenzene as an alternative to photocontrol structural cytotoxic effects of metal-free and disulfide oxidized hSOD1 in pathogenesis of ALS
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9018-9026

This study presents a novel photopharmacological strategy to mitigate the cytotoxic effects of apo-hSOD1S–S, a misfolded protein implicated in neurodegenerative diseases.
